circuitIdentityNote: Equal to the verifier's VERIFIER_HASH() by design: a proof carries bytes4(circuitIdentity) as its selector and the verifier demands bytes4(VERIFIER_HASH()).

selfCheck.meaning: The same code reproduced the values 11377 published, so the word order, word 1 and the address padding are verified before the deployable inputs changed.

sourceToKeyManifestArtefact: prover build record: rebuild/build/provenance/build-files.json from the clean re-run (DRIVER_EXIT=0). It holds source commits, both ELF hashes, both host hashes and the nested source-manifest digest.
sourceToKeyManifestNote: The field's own comment pins "the separately retained source/ELF/VK evidence file", so it is this record file. 0x ddc1084c... is the sha256 of its NESTED sourceManifest key, not of the file.

termsNote: Explicit namespace/version tags, NOT content hashes of source files. The guest program keys, the suite preimage, the verified runtime and the immutable race terms bind behaviour separately. Decided 2026-09-13 (authoritative note); never carried into the guest line records until now, so 11377s unpublished statement was true of 11377 and not of the fleet. Do not relabel old synthetic proof evidence.

runtimeHosts.note: SP1 host binaries for the CUDA runtime path. PROVER_BACKEND selects the prover: unset or "cpu" -> CpuProver, "cuda" -> CudaProver, any other value is a hard error before proving. Guests, program keys, the suite, the terms and the plan format do not depend on this.
runtimeHosts.buildCommand: cargo build --offline --locked --release -j 8 -p volume-chunk-host --bin volume-range-proof --bin volume-range-groth16 --features groth16-native
